verses.en: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.sm: Isaraelu ma fafine o Mitiana Ua nonofo Isaraelu i Setima; ona amata lea ona faitaaga o le nuu ma fafine o Moapi.

verses.en: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.sm: Ua latou aami foi i le nuu i taulaga i o latou atua; ona aa! ai lea o le nuu, ma ifo atu i O latou atua.

verses.en: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
verses.sm: Ua faatasia foi Isaraelu ma Paalapeoro; ona tupu ai lea o le toasa o le ALII ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o le ALII ia Mose, la e ave alii uma o le nuu, ma faatantan ia te i latou i le la, i luma o le ALII, ina ia liuesea le toasa tele o le Aw: ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Mose i faamasino o Isaraelu, la outou taitasi ma fasioti i ona tagata na latou faatasi ma Paalapeoro.

verses.en: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: Faauta foi, o le tasi tagata mai le fanauga a Isaraelu ua sau, ua ia au mai i ona uso o le fafine Mitiana, i luma o Mose, ma luma o le faapotopotoga uma o le fanauga a Isaraelu, a o fetagisi i latou i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.sm: Ua iloa foi e Fineaso le atalii o Eleasaro, o le atalii ia o Arona le faitaulaga; ona tulai ai lea o ia ai totonu o le faapotopotoga, ua ave le tao i lona lima.

verses.en: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.sm: Ua mulimuli atu foi o ia i le tagata o Isaraelu i le afeafe, ua sosoa ua ati ia te i laua, o le tagata o Isaraelu, atoa foi ma le fafine i lona manava; ona taofia ai lea o le faamai ai le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.sm: O ena ou foi ile faamai e luafulu o afe ma le fa o afe i latou.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.sm: O Fineaso le atalii o Eleasaro, o le atalii o Arona le faitaulaga ua liueseina ai loʻu ita i le fanauga a Isaraelu, i loʻu maelega ia te i latou, ua ou le faaumatia ai le fanauga a Isaraelu i loʻu fua.

verses.en: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.sm: O lenei, ia e fai atu, Faauta, ou te tuuina atu ia te ia laʻu feagaiga e manuia ai;

verses.en: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.sm: e ia te ia ma lana fanau pe a mavae atu o ia, o le feagaiga o le faiva o le faitaulaga e faavavau, aua na maelega o ia ona o lona Atua, na faia foi e ia le togiola mo le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
verses.sm: O le igoa foi o le tagata Isaraelu na fasiotia, o le na fasiotia faatasi ma le fafine Mitiana, o Semeri le atalii o Salu, o le alii sili foi o ia o le tasi aiga o sa Simeona.

verses.en: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
verses.sm: O le igoa foi o le fafine Mitiana ua fasiotia, o Kosepi le afafine o Suro, o le alii sili o ia O le tasi aiga o Mitiana.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
verses.sm: la outou faatiga ia Mitiana, ma fafasi ia te i latou;

verses.en: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
verses.sm: aua ua latou faatiga ia te outou i a latou mailei, ua latou maileia ai outou i le mea a Peoro, ma le mea a Kosepi le afafine o le tasi alii sili o Mitiana, o lo latou fafine na fasiotia i le aso o le faamai ona O le mea a Peoro.
